rationale.A: CRITICAL findings #1 and #3 alone make the library unreliable. Partial scope failure poisoning global state means a single transient network issue or misconfigured remote causes ALL scope results to be discarded. The set -euo pipefail violation means the safety model is fundamentally broken — the library can kill its caller.
rationale.B: All 4 CRITICAL and 8 HIGH findings are fixable without redesign. The core architecture (multi-scope detection with caching) is sound; the bugs are in error handling, state management, portability, and validation logic. Fixing these would produce a correct library.
rationale.C: Not fundamentally flawed — the multi-scope detection strategy is correct, the caching approach is appropriate, and the three STEELMAN claims confirm core primitives work. A redesign would be overkill.
rationale.D: The REDTEAM synthesis is comprehensive with 13 convergent findings across 10 agents. No additional information would change the assessment of CRITICAL/HIGH severity.
